### Recent News

- I will give a presentation at the 22nd Symposium on Second Language Writing (SSLW 2026) at Kyoto University (October 23-25). See [details](https://pmatsuda.net/sslw/).

   1. AI-based feedback vs. model text feedback in L2 writing: Effects on writing quality and learners’ affective factors by Atsushi Doi (Tohoku Univ.), Soma Sekiguchi(Tohoku Univ.), & **Atsushi Miura**

- I will give three presentations at TL/MAPPL at Hokkaido University (June 20-21). See [details](https://ken.ieice.org/ken/program/index.php?tgs_regid=4a97f9cd92508b5b3d98a66c0e531a41e38145ff63757493fec639718ff59828&tgid=IEICE-TL).

   1. Effects of Extensive L2 exposure on L1 and L2 lexical processing in Japanese children: An ERP study by **Atsushi Miura**, Tomomi Mizuochi-Endo, & Shiro Ojima.

   2. Predictive processing in Japanese learners of L2 English: An ERP investigation by Yuhui Huang (Harvard Univ.), **Atsushi Miura**, Jesse Snedeker (Harvard Univ.), Shiro Ojima.

   3. Linguistic function of Broca's area revealed by working memory activity recorded by MEG by Manabu Tanifuji, Jihyun Park, **Atsushi Miura**, Shinji Nishimoto (Osaka Univ.), & Hiromu Sakai.

- I will give a presentation at the 41st Annual Meeting of Japan Biomagnetism and Bioelectromagnetics Society (JBBS) at Iwate, Japan (June 12-13). See [details](https://jbiomag41.sgk.iwate-u.ac.jp/).

   1. Delayed picture naming tasks for visualizing spatiotemporal patterns of neural activities estimated from MEG recordings by Manabu Tanifuji, Jihyun Park, **Atsushi Miura**, Itsuki Hamada, Shinji Nishimoto (Osaka Univ.), & Hiromu Sakai.
